The use of `$_rockname` in variable expansions is safe as it is a simple string substitution defined earlier in the file. The `source` array references a predictable GitHub archive URL based on the package version, and while the URL uses string interpolation, it does not involve untrusted or dynamically fetched content at parse time. No code is executed during sourcing that would lead to data exfiltration, remote code execution, or other malicious behavior. Therefore, running `makepkg --printsrcinfo` on this PKGBUILD is safe.
</details>
